info.name: IGPS Service — BePay Global Payments
info.description:
Full API collection for @bepay/igps-service.

Setup:
1. Run the "Signup" or "Login" request first
2. Tokens are auto-saved to collection variables
3. All authenticated requests use {{accessToken}} automatically

Google OAuth Testing:
1. Get a Google ID token from frontend sign-in SDK
2. Paste the token into "Google Login" request
3. Update email, googleId, and name fields
4. Run "Google Login" - creates account or logs in existing user
5. Works with 2FA - if enabled, use "Verify 2FA During Login"

2FA Testing:
1. Run "Setup 2FA" to get QR code & backup codes
2. Scan QR with Google Authenticator/Authy
3. Run "Verify & Enable 2FA" with 6-digit code
4. Login will now require 2FA verification
5. Use "Verify 2FA During Login" to complete login

Base URL: http://localhost:3002

exec: console.log('⚠️ 2FA Required. Use "Verify 2FA During Login" request with userId:', d.userId);
console.log('⚠️ 2FA Required. Use "Verify 2FA During Login" request with userId:', d.userId);
console.log('✅ Google login successful. Provider:', d.provider);

item.name: Disable 2FA (Password)
item.description: Disable 2FA using password. For password-based accounts only. Google OAuth users must use 'Disable 2FA (OAuth - Backup Code)' instead.

item.name: Disable 2FA (OAuth - Backup Code)
item.description: Disable 2FA for Google OAuth accounts that have no password. Pass a backup code in the 'password' field — the server will detect the OAuth account and verify the backup code instead.

item.name: Get All Countries
item.description: Returns all 248 Mesta-supported countries with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Use for country dropdown in sender/beneficiary forms.

item.name: Get States for Country (US)
item.description: Returns state/province codes for a country (ISO 3166-2). Returns empty array for countries with no documented state codes. Supports: US, IN, CA, AU, BR, AR, MX, CO, DE, GB, FR, ES, IT, PT, NL, AE, JP, KR, TH, VN, PH, ID, HK, AT, BE, CH, NO, NG.

request.description:
Create a business sender. Only ONE sender (individual or business) allowed per account.

After creation, you must:
1. Upload documents (business_registration_proof + address_proof)
2. Create UBO (Ultimate Beneficial Owner)
3. Trigger verification

Note: Use US-CA format for state codes. Business type: corporation, sole proprietorship, limited liability company, partnership, other.

Get sender profile by ID.

✅ Security: You can only access your own sender. Attempting to access another user's sender will return 404 (not found).

Use 'Get My Sender Profile' if you don't know your sender ID.

Get virtual bank account details for a sender (to fund the wallet).

✅ Security: You can only access deposit accounts for your own sender. Returns 404 for unauthorized access.

⚠️ Note: This endpoint calls the Mesta API. Status codes:
- 200: Success
- 404: Sender not found or unauthorized
- 502: Mesta API error
- 503: Mesta service unavailable

Upload business registration proof document.

✅ Security: You can only upload documents to your own sender.

Required fields:
- fileName: Document file name
- type: 'business_registration_proof'
- blob: Base64-encoded PDF or image content

Upload address proof document.

✅ Security: You can only upload documents to your own sender.

Required fields:
- fileName: Document file name
- type: 'address_proof'
- blob: Base64-encoded PDF or image content

Create Ultimate Beneficial Owner for a business sender. Required before sender verification.

✅ Security: You can only create UBOs for your own sender.

Required fields: firstName, lastName, email, phone, birthDate, ownershipPercent, address, identity.

US senders: identity.documentType must be SSN4, SSN9, or TAX_ID.
Total ownershipPercent across all UBOs cannot exceed 100%.
Multiple UBOs can be added by calling this endpoint multiple times.

Create a beneficiary with a crypto wallet address (for fiat-to-stablecoin flows).

Required paymentInfo fields:
- paymentType: crypto_wallet
- address: blockchain wallet address
- chain: ethereum, polygon, solana, or tron

Supported tokens: USDC (ETH, SOL, POL), USDT (ETH, SOL, POL, TRX)

Create a payment order. For B2B orders to India (and other listed countries), an invoice document is REQUIRED.

The documents array accepts objects with:
- type: 'invoice'
- blob: base64-encoded PDF content

For testing, you can generate a minimal base64 PDF or use a real invoice.",

item.name: Refresh Order (Sync from Mesta)
item.description: Syncs order status, deposit info (wallet address or bank account), transfer type, and payout reference from Mesta. Use this to populate null fields or check for status updates.
